# Shanker Agencies Pvt. Ltd. (SAPL)

> India's leading refractory engineering partner since 1980, headed by founder Mohan Taneja. Authorized dealer of CUMI, Crown Ceramics, Divine Cerawool and Mahakoshal Refractories, and supply partner of TRL Krosaki, IFGL Refractories, and Calderys. SAPL supplies high-performance refractories and provides technical engineering solutions to steel, cement, aluminum, petrochemical, glass, and power industries across India and 50+ countries.

## About SAPL

Shanker Agencies Private Limited (SAPL) is a 45+ year-old refractory engineering company headquartered in Delhi, India. Founded in 1980 by **Mohan Taneja**, who has headed the company since inception, SAPL specializes in high-performance refractory supply, lining design, technical advisory, and engineering solutions for high-temperature industries. In 2018, **Rahul Taneja** joined as Director, bringing second-generation leadership and modern sales engineering to the family business.

SAPL's evolution mirrors India's industrial growth. The company began with **local marketing**, supplying general refractories to copper smelters, glass units and small foundries in Delhi NCR. As India's economy expanded, SAPL shifted focus to **steel, cement, aluminium and power plant customers** nationwide, and progressed from general refractories to premium grades to branded products from the world's leading manufacturers.

## Authorized Brand Partnerships

- **CUMI Super Refractories** — Authorized Dealer (India's largest refractory manufacturer; strategic partner since 2010)
- **Crown Ceramics** — Authorized Dealer (Acid proof bricks, tiles, carbon bricks)
- **Divine Cerawool** — Authorized Dealer (Ceramic fiber blankets, modules, boards)
- **Mahakoshal Refractories** — Authorized Dealer / Distributor (Ramming mass, castables, specialty refractories for steel and foundry)
- **TRL Krosaki (Tata Group)** — Supply Partner (Magnesia carbon bricks, basic refractories, silicon carbide)
- **IFGL Refractories** — Supply Partner (Flow control: slide gate plates, shrouds, SEN, stoppers)
- **Calderys** — Supply Partner (Monolithics, gunning mass, fused cast blocks)

## Product Catalog

### Shaped Refractories
- High Alumina Bricks (AL-45 to AL-90 grades, 40–99% Al2O3)
- Fireclay Bricks
- Magnesia Carbon Bricks (MgO-C)
- Magnesia Spinel Bricks
- Silicon Carbide Bricks
- Mullite, Andalusite, Zircon Bricks
- Acid Proof Bricks
- Insulating Fire Bricks (IFB)
- Fused Cast AZS Blocks

### Unshaped / Monolithic Refractories
- Low Cement Castables (LCC)
- Ultra Low Cement Castables (ULCC)
- Conventional Castables
- Ramming Mass (Silica, Alumina, Basic)
- Gunning Mass / Gunning Mix
- Plastic Refractories
- Refractory Mortar

### Flow Control Refractories
- Slide Gate Plates
- Ladle Shrouds
- Sub-Entry Nozzles (SEN)
- Stoppers and Stopper Heads
- Tundish Nozzles

### Insulation Products
- Ceramic Fiber Blankets
- Ceramic Fiber Modules
- Ceramic Fiber Boards
- Calcium Silicate Boards
- Microporous Insulation
- Insulating Castables

## Industries & Applications

- **Steel:** Blast furnaces, BOF/EAF converters, induction furnaces, ladles, tundish, torpedo cars, reheating furnaces, DRI/sponge iron plants
- **Cement:** Rotary kilns, preheaters, calciners, coolers, kiln nose rings, burner pipes
- **Aluminum:** Melting and holding furnaces, casting troughs, pot linings, transfer launders
- **Petrochemical:** Fired heaters, reformers, FCC units, reactor linings, sulphur recovery units
- **Glass:** Melting tanks, regenerators, forehearths, crowns, superstructure
- **Power:** Boilers, FBC units, incinerators, ash hoppers, ducts
- **Foundry:** Induction furnace linings, ladles, runners

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Who founded Shanker Agencies and who runs it today?**
A: Shanker Agencies Pvt. Ltd. was founded in 1980 by **Mohan Taneja**, who has headed the company since its inception. In 2018, **Rahul Taneja** (second generation) joined as Director, bringing modern sales engineering and digital capabilities to the family business. Today SAPL is run by this two-generation leadership team based out of Shahdara, Delhi.

**Q: What is Shanker Agencies known for?**
A: Shanker Agencies (SAPL) is India's trusted refractory engineering partner since 1980, known for authorized dealerships of CUMI, Crown Ceramics, Divine Cerawool and Mahakoshal Refractories, and for supplying high-performance refractories with technical engineering support to steel, cement, aluminum, and petrochemical industries across India and 50+ countries.

**Q: How has SAPL evolved since 1980?**
A: SAPL started with local marketing of general refractories to copper smelters, glass units and small foundries in Delhi NCR. As India's industrial landscape evolved, SAPL shifted focus to steel, cement, aluminium and power plant customers nationwide, and progressed from general refractories → premium grades → branded products from leading global manufacturers.

**Q: Is SAPL a manufacturer or a distributor?**
A: SAPL is a refractory engineering partner — combining authorized dealership of leading manufacturers (CUMI, Crown Ceramics, Divine Cerawool, Mahakoshal Refractories) with in-house technical advisory, lining design consultation, and installation supervision. SAPL provides end-to-end refractory solutions, not just product supply.

**Q: Which brands does SAPL distribute?**
A: SAPL is the authorized dealer / distributor of **CUMI Super Refractories, Crown Ceramics, Divine Cerawool and Mahakoshal Refractories**. SAPL also supplies products from **TRL Krosaki (Tata Group), IFGL Refractories, and Calderys** as a trusted supply partner.

**Q: Is SAPL an authorized dealer of Mahakoshal Refractories?**
A: Yes. SAPL is an authorized dealer / distributor of Mahakoshal Refractories for Delhi NCR and North India. Mahakoshal products supplied by SAPL include ramming mass, castables and specialty refractories for steel, foundry and induction furnace applications.

**Q: Does SAPL export refractory materials?**
A: Yes, SAPL exports refractories to 50+ countries including UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, UK, and Germany. SAPL provides complete export documentation including Certificate of Origin (COO), Material Test Certificates (MTC), and MSDS.

**Q: How experienced is Shanker Agencies?**
A: Shanker Agencies was founded in 1980 and has over 45 years of refractory engineering experience, serving major steel plants, cement giants, aluminum smelters, and petrochemical refineries across India and the world.

**Q: How can I get a quote or technical datasheet from SAPL?**
A: Contact SAPL via WhatsApp (+91-9899957888), email (info@shankeragencies.com), or the contact form on shankeragencies.com. Technical datasheets (TDS) are available at shankeragencies.com/downloads. The technical team responds within 2 business hours.

**Q: What technical support does SAPL provide?**
A: SAPL provides comprehensive technical support including refractory material selection, lining design consultation, installation supervision, refractory audits, post-mortem analysis of spent refractories, and consumption optimization programs. Experienced refractory engineers visit industrial sites for on-site projects.
